subject: Ciências
description_pt: Classificar equipamentos elétricos residenciais (chuveiro, ferro, lâmpadas, TV, rádio, geladeira etc.) de acordo com o tipo de transformação de energia (da energia elétrica para a térmica, luminosa, sonora e mecânica, por exemplo).

components.description_pt: Identificar o tipo de energia produzida (térmica, luz, som ou mecânica) por eletrodomésticos comuns
components.description_en: Identify the type of energy output (thermal, light, sound, or mechanical) produced by common household appliances
components.cc_component_description: Identify multiple macroscopic forms in which energy manifests, including motion, sound, light, and thermal energy

components.description_pt: Classificar eletrodomésticos de acordo com o tipo de transformação de energia que realizam
components.description_en: Classify household electrical appliances according to the type of energy transformation they perform
components.cc_component_description: Classify observable phenomena according to the form of energy they represent at the macroscopic scale

components.description_pt: Explicar que energia elétrica é convertida em outras formas de energia nos eletrodomésticos
components.description_en: Explain that electrical energy is converted into other forms of energy in household appliances
components.cc_component_description: Explain that 'producing energy' refers to converting stored energy into a useful form

cc_matches.description: At the macroscopic scale, energy manifests itself in multiple ways, such as in motion, sound, light, and thermal energy.
The expression “produce energy” typically refers to the conversion of stored energy into a desired form for practical use.
